abstract: Adhesion-defective EC cells were isolated from a population of mutagenized F9 cells by serial transfer of cells that did not adhere to gelatin-coated dishes. The variant cells grew in suspension as multicellular clusters of loosely aggregated cells. The cells adhered to, but did not flatten on, fibroblast monolayers and extracellular matrix produced by parietal-like endoderm. Two different mutant cell lines exhibited increased sensitivity to the lectin abrin and decreased sensitivity to wheat germ agglutinin, suggesting that changes in cell surface glycosylation are associated with the mutant phenotype. These adhesion-defective mutants were used to study the relationship between cell-cell adhesion and endodermal differentiation. Unlike wild-type cells, when cultured with low concentrations of retinoic acid (RA) in suspension culture, the mutant cells did not form embryoid bodies but remained as loosely adhering strings of cells. Electron microscopic examination revealed that most of the differentiated variant cells resembled parietal endoderm, and this was confirmed by immunofluorescent staining for TROMA-3 marker. The levels of some of the markers that characterize the differentiative pathways were examined by immunoprecipitation and by enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay (ELISA). The variant line produced higher levels of laminin and type IV collagen compared to the wild-type cells. alpha-Fetoprotein (AFP) was produced at a significantly lower level by the variant compared to wild-type F9 cells during the differentiative process. The results show that variant cells differentiated toward parietal endoderm but have a very much restricted ability to differentiate to visceral endoderm. We conclude that aggregation and/or compaction provide some essential signals during the differentiation of F9 cells into epithelial layers of visceral endoderm.
abstract_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞の変異株を、ゼラチンコート皿への非接着細胞の連続継代により単離した。変異細胞は緩く凝集した多細胞クラスターとして浮遊増殖した。細胞は線維芽細胞単層や壁側内胚葉の産生する細胞外マトリックスには接着したが、扁平化はしなかった。2株の変異株は、リシンに対する感受性が高まり、コムギ胚芽凝集素に対する感受性が低下しており、細胞表面糖鎖の変化が示唆された。レチノイン酸(RA)の低濃度で浮遊培養すると、野生型細胞は胚様体を形成したが、変異細胞は胚様体を形成せず、緩く接着した細胞の連なりのままであった。電子顕微鏡観察では、分化した変異細胞の多くは壁側内胚葉に類似していた。これはTROMA-3マーカーの免疫蛍光染色により確認された。分化経路の指標となるマーカーの一部について、免疫沈降法と酵素免疫測定法(ELISA)で量を検討した。変異株は野生型よりラミニンとIV型コラーゲンを多く産生した。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は分化過程で、変異株では野生型F9細胞より有意に低いレベルで産生された。本研究の結果は、変異細胞は壁側内胚葉へ分化するが、臓側内胚葉へ分化する能力は著しく制限されていることを示している。細胞間の接着および/または凝集が、F9細胞の臓側内胚葉上皮層への分化過程において必須のシグナルを与えると結論づける。
